# Forage United Kingdom

> A free guide to wild food in the UK: which wild plants are in season in each region and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 22 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Stinging nettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/nettle/): Urtica dioica; Nettle. In season March to June.
- [Wild garlic](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/wildgarlic/): Allium ursinum; Ramsons. In season March to May.
- [Dandelion](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/dandelion/): Taraxacum officinale; Dandelion. In season March to October.
- [Ground elder](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/groundelder/): Aegopodium podagraria; Ground elder. In season March to June.
- [Chickweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/chickweed/): Stellaria media; Chickweed. In season March to November.
- [Common sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/sorrel/): Rumex acetosa; Sorrel. In season April to August.
- [Wood sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/woodsorrel/): Oxalis acetosella; Wood sorrel. In season April to September.
- [Garlic mustard](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/garlicmustard/): Alliaria petiolata; Jack-by-the-hedge. In season March to June.
- [Fat hen](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/fathen/): Chenopodium album; Fat hen. In season May to September.
- [Ribwort plantain](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/plantain/): Plantago lanceolata; Ribwort plantain. In season April to September.
- [Watercress](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/watercress/): Nasturtium officinale; Watercress. In season March to October.
- [Hop shoots](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/hops/): Humulus lupulus; Hop shoots. In season March to May.
- [Sea beet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/seabeet/): Beta vulgaris subsp. maritima; Sea beet. In season March to October.
- [Marsh samphire](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/samphire/): Salicornia europaea; Marsh samphire. In season June to August.
- [Dulse](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/dulse/): Palmaria palmata; Dulse. In season April to September.
- [Sugar kelp](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/kelp/): Saccharina latissima; Sugar kelp. In season March to June.
- [Laver](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/laver/): Porphyra umbilicalis; Laver. In season October to April.
- [Blue mussels](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/mussel/): Mytilus edulis; Mussels. In season January to December.
- [Blackberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/blackberry/): Rubus fruticosus; Blackberry, Bramble. In season August to September.
- [Wild raspberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/raspberry/): Rubus idaeus; Wild raspberry. In season July to August.
- [Bilberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/bilberry/): Vaccinium myrtillus; Bilberry, Whortleberry. In season July to August.
- [Lingonberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/lingonberry/): Vaccinium vitis-idaea; Cowberry. In season August to October.
- [Cloudberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/cloudberry/): Rubus chamaemorus; Cloudberry. In season July to August.
- [Wild strawberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/strawberry/): Fragaria vesca; Wild strawberry. In season June to July.
- [Elderberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/elderberry/): Sambucus nigra; Elderberry. In season August to September.
- [Elderflower](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/elderflower/): Sambucus nigra; Elderflower. In season May to June.
- [Sloe](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/sloe/): Prunus spinosa; Sloe, Blackthorn. In season September to November.
- [Rose hips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/rosehip/): Rosa canina; Rose hips. In season September to November.
- [Rowan berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/rowan/): Sorbus aucuparia; Rowan, Mountain ash. In season August to October.
- [Hawthorn](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/hawthorn/): Crataegus monogyna; Hawthorn, Haws. In season September to October.
- [Crab apple](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/crabapple/): Malus sylvestris; Crab apple. In season September to October.
- [Sea buckthorn](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/seabuckthorn/): Hippophae rhamnoides; Sea buckthorn. In season August to October.
- [Crowberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/crowberry/): Empetrum nigrum; Crowberry. In season August to September.
- [Wild gooseberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/gooseberry/): Ribes uva-crispa; Gooseberry. In season June to July.
- [Juniper berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/juniper/): Juniperus communis; Juniper. In season September to November.
- [Hazelnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/hazelnut/): Corylus avellana; Hazelnut, Cobnut. In season August to October.
- [Sweet chestnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/chestnut/): Castanea sativa; Sweet chestnut. In season October to November.
- [Walnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/walnut/): Juglans regia; Walnut. In season September to October.
- [Beechnut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/beechnut/): Fagus sylvatica; Beechnut, Beech mast. In season September to October.
- [Meadowsweet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/meadowsweet/): Filipendula ulmaria; Meadowsweet. In season June to August.
- [Lime blossom](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/linden/): Tilia cordata; Lime, Linden. In season June to July.
- [Wild chamomile](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/chamomile/): Matricaria chamomilla; Chamomile. In season June to August.
- [Wild thyme](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/thyme/): Thymus serpyllum; Wild thyme. In season June to August.
- [Yarrow](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/yarrow/): Achillea millefolium; Yarrow. In season June to September.
- [Red clover](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/redclover/): Trifolium pratense; Red clover. In season May to September.
- [Burdock root](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/burdock/): Arctium lappa; Burdock. In season April to October.

## Dishes

- [Elderflower cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/elderflower-cordial/): Flower heads steeped overnight with lemon and citric acid, strained into sugar syrup.
- [Sloe gin](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/sloe-gin/): Pricked sloes steeped in gin with sugar from October until Christmas.
- [Dandelion and burdock](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/dandelion-and-burdock/): Old northern English soft drink brewed from the roots, with ginger and sugar.
- [Rose hip syrup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/rose-hip-syrup/): Wartime vitamin C syrup of rose hips, strained twice to remove the hairs.
- [Meadowsweet cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/meadowsweet-cordial/): Almond-scented cordial from meadowsweet flowers.
- [Elderflower fritters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/elderflower-fritters/): Flower heads in light batter, fried and dusted with sugar.
- [Moules marinière](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/moules-marini-re/): Mussels steamed with wine, shallots and parsley.
- [Samphire with butter](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/samphire-with-butter/): Steamed samphire tossed in butter, beside fish.
- [Wild garlic pesto](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/wild-garlic-pesto/): Ramsons blended with hard cheese, nuts, oil and lemon.
- [Bramble jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/bramble-jelly/): Blackberries with crab apples for set, strained into a clear jelly.
- [Hedgerow jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/hedgerow-jelly/): Autumn's hedgerow fruits cooked together and strained.
- [Hawthorn ketchup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/hawthorn-ketchup/): Haws simmered in vinegar, sieved and sweetened into a fruity ketchup.
- [Rowan jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/rowan-jelly/): Traditional Scottish jelly for venison.
- [Nettle soup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/nettle-soup/): Nettle tops simmered with potato and onion, blended with cream.
- [Laverbread with cockles and bacon](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/laverbread-with-cockles-and-bacon/): The Welsh breakfast of laverbread, cockles and bacon.
- [Sea beet and potato soup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/sea-beet-and-potato-soup/): Sea beet simmered with potato and stock.
- [Chestnut and mushroom roast](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/chestnut-and-mushroom-roast/): Roasted chestnuts in a nut roast with mushrooms.
- [Wild garlic soda bread](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/wild-garlic-soda-bread/): Irish-style soda bread with chopped ramsons and cheese.
- [Blackberry and apple crumble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/blackberry-and-apple-crumble/): Blackberries and apple under a buttery crumble, with custard.
- [Gooseberry fool](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/gooseberry-fool/): Stewed gooseberries with elderflower folded into cream.
- [Bilberry pie](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/bilberry-pie/): Yorkshire 'mucky mouth' pie of bilberries.
- [Cranachan with raspberries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/cranachan-with-raspberries/): Toasted oats, whisky, honey, cream and wild raspberries.
